hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Count frequencies of all numbers using a frequency map or array.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Determine the maximum frequency among all distinct values.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Sum the frequencies of all elements that achieve this maximum frequency.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: length of input array nums
complexity.notes: Hash map frequency counting and summation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic element frequency searches are unnecessary.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) extra space for frequency table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash map or frequency array for linear time counting.
